valuation_template_rationale: Tesla combines a profitable but cyclical automotive and energy base with pre-profit autonomy, robotics and AI-enabled optionality; no specialized repository template captures both, so a full sum-of-parts review must separate the components and make net cash, dilution and capital intensity explicit.
rating_change_conditions: Restore valuation support only after the dependent full review supplies current diluted-share and net-cash inputs and ordered bear, base and bull sum-of-parts assumptions with probabilities totaling 100 for automotive, energy and AI-enabled optionality; upgrade only if canonical expected-return, base-upside, payoff and margin-of-safety gates clear, and downgrade if vehicle demand, margins, cash conversion, autonomy execution, capital productivity, governance or liquidity deteriorates.
